description.text: We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to reinventing the treatment of human disease through the development of innovative, highly differentiated oral medicines that address significant health problems and meaningfully improve patients’ lives. We are committed to advancing novel technologies to address targets that have known disease-causing biology, but which have not been drugged, or have been inadequately drugged, often based on limitations of existing technologies. Our approach is intended to discover and develop a new generation of medicines in a disease-agnostic manner. We are a leader in targeted protein degradation (TPD), a next-generation small molecule therapeutic modality that engages the body’s natural cellular recycling system to selectively eliminate disease-causing proteins. Our objective is to develop molecules that are both potent and highly selective, creating the unique potential to address diseases that are poorly served by current treatment options. To date, we have progressed multiple programs into clinical development and expect to advance at least one new molecular entity into clinical testing annually. We intend to leverage our drug development expertise to become a fully integrated biopharmaceutical company with an industry-leading pipeline of novel medicines. Our current discovery and development efforts are primarily directed at high-value targets in immunology.

about.description_short: Kymera is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the field of targeted protein degradation (TPD) to develop medicines that address critical health problems and have the potential to dramatically improve patients' lives. Kymera is deploying TPD to address disease targets and pathways inaccessible with conventional therapeutics. Having advanced the first degrader into the clinic for immunological diseases, Kymera is focused on building an industry-leading pipeline of oral small molecule degraders to provide a new generation of convenient, highly effective therapies for patients with these conditions. Founded in 2016, Kymera has been recognized as one of Boston's top workplaces for the past several years.

analysis_md:
# KYMR — Kymera Therapeutics, Inc.
Engine 5.5.0 run, 2026-10-20. Price $113.41 (nasdaq_quote_api, key_numbers.md), market cap $9.582B — in scope under $40B.

All figures below are copied from key_numbers.md, dcf_numbers.json, ttm.json, financials_history.csv or fundamentals.json — none are recomputed.

## What it is
Clinical-stage biotechnology (SIC 2836) developing oral small-molecule targeted protein degraders for immunological diseases. Lead candidate KT-621, a once-daily oral STAT6 degrader, is in parallel Phase 2b studies — BROADEN2 in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (enrollment completed ahead of schedule; top-line data expected by year-end 2026, Phase 3 planned from mid-2027) and BREADTH in eosinophilic asthma (data expected late 2027) — with FDA Fast Track designation. KT-579 (IRF5) is in Phase 1, KT-485/SAR447971 (IRAK4, with Sanofi) has entered Phase 1, and KT-200 (CDK2 molecular glue, with Gilead) was option-exercised by Gilead. There is no approved product and no product revenue: all revenue is collaboration revenue.

## Owner's earnings
- FY2025 (financials_history.csv): operating cash flow $-232,891,000; capex $1,449,000; SBC $59,904,000.
- **Conservative owner's earnings FY2025: $-294,244,000 = $-3.48/share** (key_numbers.md: latest FY OE/share $-3.48, latest FY OE total $-294.2M, shares diluted latest 84,490,585).
- Maintenance version FY2025 (financials_history.csv): $-413,233,000 — even more negative than the conservative figure, so the choice of definition does not change the verdict.
- OE positive 0 of the last 5 fiscal years (key_numbers.md). Normalized base (3-yr median) is $-3.48/share, identical to the latest year — there is no distorted positive year to argue over.
- **Base used = the normalized median base, $-3.48/share** (base_source: median_of_last_3_fy_oe_per_share). The TTM check below confirms the same sign, so no TTM pin was used.
- Balance sheet (FY2025, financials_history.csv): cash $357,011,000, total assets $1,742,812,000, total liabilities $163,148,000, equity $1,579,664,000, lease liabilities $78,975,000, and no debt tags filed (see DEBT_TAGS_BLANK). Q2 2026 reporting put cash, equivalents and investments at about $1.5B with runway into 2029 — the bulk of the asset base is marketable securities, not the cash tag alone.

**TTM check (ttm.py, through 2026-06-30):**
- OCF: FY $-232,891,000 − prior YTD $-139,034,000 + current YTD $-142,905,000 = **TTM $-236,762,000**
- Capex: FY $1,449,000 − prior YTD $1,162,000 + current YTD $907,000 = **TTM $1,194,000**
- SBC: FY $59,904,000 − prior YTD $29,649,000 + current YTD $34,945,000 = **TTM $65,200,000**
- Shares (current-YTD weighted diluted): **97,857,489**
- **TTM OE total $-303,156,000 → TTM OE/share $-3.10** (ttm.json). H1 2026 collaboration revenue of $99,365,000 in the Q2 2026 filing (including the $45,000,000 Gilead option fee and $20,000,000 Sanofi milestone in Q2) did not make TTM owner's earnings positive, because R&D burn overwhelms milestone revenue.

## Moat: 3/10 — weak, unproven
Justification: Clinical-stage platform with no approved product, no product revenue, and no demonstrated returns on capital. The roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json is deeply negative every recent year (-30.2% in 2022, -45.9% in 2023, -28.9% in 2024, -22.6% in 2025), and gross margin is not filed in fundamentals.json (no COGS, because there are no product sales), so there is no ROIC-above-cost-of-capital or pricing-power evidence to support a higher score.
- FOR: First-in-class oral STAT6 degrader KT-621 in Phase 2b for atopic dermatitis and asthma, with FDA Fast Track and Phase 1b biomarker/clinical signals; targeted protein degradation platform validated by partnerships — Sanofi (KT-485/SAR447971 IRAK4) and Gilead (KT-200 CDK2, option exercised); large cash and investments position (about $1.5B at 2026-06-30 per Q2 2026 reporting, runway into 2029) funds the pipeline without debt.
- AGAINST: No approved product, no product revenue and no demonstrated returns on capital — owner's earnings negative 0/5 of the last 5 years; revenue is 100% collaboration milestones/deferred revenue, lumpy and partner-dependent, with management stating no further 2026 revenue is expected after the Q2 2026 milestones; concentration and binary trial risk — value rests mainly on KT-621; heavy dilution and SBC — diluted shares growing 16.1%/yr and SBC rising every year.
- A 3 gives CAP = 5.9 years (key_numbers.md): growth would hold 2 years, then converge to the 2.5% terminal rate over 5.9 years — moot on a negative base.

## DCF — final run
The engine returns no scenarios on a negative normalized base: **Tier F, sub-type no_cash_generation** (key_numbers.md: "No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone"; "F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive)"). Probabilities used were the defaults 10/25/30/25/10 and moat 3, but no IV or IRR is computed — implied IRR, IV@15%, IV@20% and IV@25% are all null in score.json. Growth blend is -10.74% (rev CAGR 5y 2.87%, rev CAGR 3y -5.74%, latest rev YoY -16.70%, share count CAGR 16.14% with a -5.00% growth adjustment, key_numbers.md) — a scenario growth-start sanity check against the prints confirms there is no positive growth base to sanity-check: latest FY revenue fell -16.70% and both the FY and TTM owner's-earnings bases are negative.

## Flags — every fragility flag resolved
- **STALE_FY** (latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago): resolved by the TTM run quoted above — TTM OE through 2026-06-30 is $-303,156,000 / $-3.10/share, still negative, so the median base stands and no --ttm pin changes the tier.
- **DILUTION** (share count growing 16.1%/yr): real and continuing. Diluted shares were 53,933,229 in 2022, 58,365,499 in 2023, 75,043,991 in 2024 and 84,490,585 in 2025 (financials_history.csv), and 97,857,489 on the TTM current-YTD basis (ttm.json). SBC rises with it: $35,480,000 in 2022, $43,118,000 in 2023, $55,012,000 in 2024, $59,904,000 in 2025, $65,200,000 TTM. Equity issuance, not cash generation, funds the burn.
- **BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT** (>60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 years): no divestiture, big M&A or restatement was found in research — the jumps are the lumpiness of collaboration revenue itself. Revenue was $72,832,000 in 2021, $46,826,000 in 2022, $78,592,000 in 2023, $47,072,000 in 2024 and $39,211,000 in 2025 (financials_history.csv), as Sanofi deferred revenue and milestones were recognized and then wound down. No revenue CAGR spanning these years is meaningful, and none is used — the tier rests on the negative OE base, not on growth.
- **NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE** (2023): net income $-146,962,000 vs operating cash flow $-102,826,000 in 2023 (financials_history.csv). The gap is the non-cash SBC addback — SBC was $43,118,000 in 2023, essentially the whole difference — not a tax deposit, impairment or one-off working-capital swing. The OCF-based conservative OE used throughout already deducts SBC in full, so the divergence does not flatter the base.
- **SHARES_FALLBACK** (no diluted count filed for 2019): that pre-IPO year uses the CommonStockSharesOutstanding fallback count of 1,929,516 (financials_history.csv, shares_tag FALLBACK) and its per-share history is approximate. It is outside the last-3-FY median window and does not affect the base.
- **DEBT_TAGS_BLANK** (no debt tag for the latest fiscal year): net debt is unknown to the engine, not zero — stated from the filing instead: FY2025 liabilities are $163,148,000 in total, including lease liabilities of $78,975,000, against cash of $357,011,000 and total assets of $1,742,812,000 (financials_history.csv), with no borrowings filed. The company is equity- and collaboration-funded; leverage is not the risk here, cash burn is.
- Share basis (key_numbers.md, informational, no flag): an in-history split fact dated 2020-08-20 with ratio 1.5949 is recorded; it is dated on or before the latest FY end, is not applied by the engine, and no share-count jump of about that ratio appears inside the last four years of financials_history.csv, so DILUTION above is real issuance, not a split artefact.

## My thoughts / overlay
- This is a pipeline-optionality price, not an owner's-earnings price: $113.41 for a company whose last five years and TTM all burn roughly $3/share of owner's earnings. The OE model has nothing to capitalize, so Tier F is the model's honest answer regardless of how the KT-621 readouts land.
- What could change the story is clinical, not financial engineering: BROADEN2 top-line data expected by year-end 2026, KT-579 Phase 1 data in Q4 2026, and any further Sanofi/Gilead milestones from 2027. None of that is in the filed OE history yet.
- The balance sheet buys time (about $1.5B of cash and investments, runway into 2029 per Q2 2026 reporting), but at the TTM burn in ttm.json and with share count already at 97,857,489 on the current-YTD basis, time is bought with dilution.
- No hurdle-clearing price is computable: on a negative base there is no price at which the filed owner's earnings clear 15%, 20% or 25%.

## Final verdict
- **Final tier: F** (no positive normalized owner's earnings; F sub-type no_cash_generation)
- Confidence: **Low** (high on the filed cash-flow history, low on any pipeline outcome — and confidence does not change a Tier F on a negative base)
- One-liner: Clinical-stage protein-degrader platform, moat 3/10, with no positive owner's earnings in any of the last 5 years — normalized base -$3.48/share and TTM -$3.10/share — Tier F on this screen; it does not clear 15% at any price on current numbers and no hurdle-clearing price is computable on a negative OE base.
